name: r2-lfs
description: Git LFS server on Cloudflare Workers and R2, with a CLI to inspect, clean up and archive LFS objects
author: Kensuke Kubo

scripts.test:e2e: docker build -f test/e2e/Dockerfile -t r2-lfs-e2e . && docker run --rm r2-lfs-e2e
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run build:pkg

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket that holds the LFS objects.

ALLOWED_REPOS.description: Comma-separated GitHub repositories this server serves, where `*` stands for any characters within a name, e.g. `my-name/*,my-org/assets,my-org/blender-*`. Required. `*` alone allows every repository of everyone.

AUTH_MODE.description: `github`: authenticate with a GitHub token and mirror the repository's permissions. `token`: accept tokens from `r2-lfs token` and `AUTH_TOKENS`.

STORAGE_LAYOUT.description: `per-repo`: store objects under `<owner>/<repo>/` so each repository can be cleaned up on its own. `shared`: one pool deduplicated across repositories.

TRANSFER_MODE.description: `auto`: use presigned URLs when the R2 API credentials below are set, otherwise proxy through the Worker. `presigned`: require those credentials. `proxy`: always go through the Worker, which caps uploads at `PROXY_MAX_UPLOAD_MB`.

PROXY_MAX_UPLOAD_MB.description: Largest upload accepted in proxy mode. Match your plan's request body limit (Free/Pro: 100).

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Only for presigned URLs. Your Cloudflare account ID (Dashboard > Workers & Pages, right sidebar).

R2_BUCKET_NAME.description: Only for presigned URLs. Must be the same name as the bucket bound to `BUCKET`.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Only for the admin UI at /_admin. Your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. `my-team.cloudflareaccess.com`. Leave empty to keep the admin UI closed.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Only for the admin UI. The Application Audience (AUD) tag of the Cloudflare Access application that protects /_admin.

ACTIONS_OIDC.description: `off`, `read` or `write`: what GitHub Actions workflows may do in their own repository by authenticating with an OIDC token (`id-token: write`), with no secret stored.

ACTIONS_OIDC_AUDIENCE.description: The audience workflows request their OIDC token for. `r2-lfs credential` reads it from the server.

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Only for presigned URLs. Create an R2 API token with Object Read & Write on the bucket (R2 > Manage API tokens).

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Only for presigned URLs. The secret that pairs with `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID`.

AUTH_TOKENS.description: Only for `AUTH_MODE=token`. Comma- or newline-separated `<owner/repo>:<r|rw|admin>:<token>` entries (`admin` can also unlock other people's file locks), where `*` may stand for any characters within a name (or be the whole scope), with tokens of 16 or more characters, e.g. `my-name/blender-*:rw:<random>`. May stay empty when you create tokens with `r2-lfs token`.
